description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked vertically at the top of column 0 (leftmost) with the cell above empty, so I must block there; strongest early in the game, weaker late. The same three in another column, horizontal or diagonal threats at column 0, my own three there, or an already-blocked three do not fire. Many weak near-threshold firings have no clear pattern.
effect: None measurable: forcing it on or off changes move probabilities by at most about 0.1 (in threat positions the model already plays column 0 with probability ~1.0).
notes: H1 (opponent open vertical three in col 0) gives dev F1 0.448, precision 0.91, recall 0.30, sim share 0.26. Minimal pairs agree strongly (col 0: 1-9, other columns: -2 to -5; blocked: off). The remaining ~70% of firing is low-amplitude (0.34-1.0) and diffuse; horizontal threats near col 0 and other cues were tested and rejected. A ply cutoff lowered F1 (0.378). Synthesis peaks around 9.5, below dev max 11.5.
